name: Liraglutide
mechanism: GLP-1 analogue increasing insulin secretion and reducing appetite
dosing: Titrated subcutaneously per product regimen; doses vary by indication
contraindications: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or MEN2; known hypersensitivity
interactions: May delay gastric emptying and thereby affect absorption of some oral medications; consider timing for oral drugs with narrow therapeutic index
monitoring: Monitor glycaemic control, GI side effects during dose titration, weight and signs of pancreatitis; consider specialist follow-up for weight management indications
pregnancy: Avoid during pregnancy; discontinue if pregnancy is planned or confirmed and seek specialist advice
sideEffects: Common: nausea and vomiting during dose titration; rare but serious: pancreatitis; may cause weight loss
clinicalPearls: Titrate dose slowly to minimise gastrointestinal adverse effects; effective for glycaemic control and weight loss in selected patients; ensure appropriate patient education on injection technique
indication: Type 2 diabetes for glycaemic control and selected licensed use for weight management under specialist pathways
